given: stock rows of which some carry codes that do not parse as location-batch-serial
when: the integrity probe runs before the change is accepted
then: it reports the count of nonconforming rows for review

independence.rationale: AC4 asserts nonconforming rows keep NULLs; this adds the distinct outcome that their count is surfaced for review before acceptance

architectural_notes: Infra layer: an integrity-probe contract that runs before the change is accepted, counting rows whose inventory_code does not parse as location-batch-serial and reporting that count for review. The probe is a read-only query owned alongside the migration (a pre-flight check), not business logic in the service or boundary. Cross-cutting concern: observability / operator review gate. Verified by a real-branch test seeding a mix of conforming and nonconforming codes and asserting the reported count matches the nonconforming rows.
